title: Question on the page "connectPagination"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[connectPagination](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectPagination.html)".

How to implement pagination in ReactNative using connectPagination?

comments.body: Hi @mvnnn thanks for opening this issue. Have you tried using [react-instantsearch](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/Getting_started_React_native.html) rather that instantsearch.js? We have a [demo here](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/tree/master/examples/react-native)

Thanks for reaching out. I want to build Pagination like this.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12225578/44536182-8314ce80-a719-11e8-90fe-fea4bfb30819.png)

but it's seems like "connectPagination" have only support for next pages, How to go to previous pages ..it have any method for that?. Can you provide some example code for that.

This contains a full implementation of a pagination using the connector:

https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectPagination.html#example
